userStories.title: Strike parser update: real export format and fiat transactions
acceptanceCriteria: Update detect() heuristic for real Strike export columns: 'amount btc', 'amount usd', 'transaction type' (current detection checks 'btc amount', 'usd amount', 'type' which don't match real exports)

Update column mapping throughout parse/parse_row for new column names: 'Date & Time (UTC)' (was 'Date'), 'Transaction Type' (was 'Type'), 'Amount USD' (was 'USD Amount'), 'Amount BTC' (was 'BTC Amount'), 'Fee USD' (was 'Fee (USD)'), 'Fee BTC' (was 'Fee (BTC)')
Map new columns not in old format: 'Reference', 'BTC Price', 'Cost Basis (USD)', 'Destination', 'Transaction Hash', 'Note'
Add Deposit handler: Transaction Type='Deposit' with positive Amount USD produces Deposit(buy_curr='USD', buy=amount_usd)
Handle deposit reversals: Transaction Type='Deposit' with negative Amount USD and Description='Reversal' produces Withdrawal(sell_curr='USD', sell=abs(amount_usd))

On-chain BTC Send: Transaction Type='Send' with Amount BTC and Destination starting with bc1/1/3 produces Withdrawal(sell_curr='BTC') — uses --withdraw-to param for exchange field (self-custody transfer)

Lightning BTC Send: Transaction Type='Send' with Amount BTC and Destination starting with lnbc produces Withdrawal(sell_curr='BTC') — uses a DIFFERENT target than --withdraw-to (on-chain wallet can't receive Lightning). Convention: if --withdraw-to is 'coldcard', Lightning BTC sends use '{withdraw_to}-lightning' or 'Strike-Lightning' as the exchange field. Exact convention TBD during implementation.

Lightning USD Send: Transaction Type='Send' with Amount USD (no Amount BTC) and lnbc Destination produces Withdrawal(sell_curr='USD', sell=abs(amount_usd)) — pure fiat debit, no BTC involved. Exchange stays 'Strike'.
All Send types: capture Fee USD when present, no fee when absent

userStories.notes: The existing Strike parser was built against an assumed CSV format. The real Strike 'All Transactions' export uses different column names and includes fiat transaction types (Deposit, USD Send) that are currently invisible to the parser. This is both a format correction and a fiat-tracking enhancement. DESIGN DECISIONS: (1) No new trans_types — all transactions use standard Trade/Deposit/Withdrawal. Goal is USD+BTC tally and cost basis tracking, not categorizing payment methods. (2) Lightning BTC sends get a different --withdraw-to target than on-chain sends because the same hardware wallet cannot receive both on-chain and Lightning. (3) Lightning USD sends (no BTC amount) are pure USD debits from the Strike account — just Withdrawal(sell_curr='USD').
